content.text:
There are 23 open PRs in maester365/maester: 18 are ready for review and 5 are drafts. None of them has a human approval yet; the only reviews so far are bot comments plus one comment from earbona23. 10 have merge conflicts with main, and 3 have failing CI.

**Unblocks everything else**
- [#2727](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2727) (yours): gets main's unit tests passing again. It merges cleanly and CI is still running. Merge this first so the other PRs can rebase onto a green main.

**New checks: Entra ID Protection (Dfrank77)**
These three are near-identical and all have merge conflicts:
- [#2688](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2688) MT.1261: medium-risk users left unremediated
- [#2689](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2689) MT.1262: high-risk service principals
- [#2704](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2704) MT.1263: medium-risk service principals

**New checks: Azure, Defender and Intune**
- [#2712](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2712) MT.1266: Azure secure score per subscription (earbona23, conflicts)
- [#2703](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2703) Defender for Cloud recommendations and attack paths (earbona23)
- [#2695](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2695) Defender device recommendations and exploitable vulnerabilities (earbona23)
- [#2694](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2694) Intune device compliance and security baseline status (earbona23, conflicts)
- [#2672](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2672) MT.1264: one result per Secure Score improvement action (Dfrank77, conflicts)

**CIS alignment**
- [#2636](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2636) aligns CIS M365 2.4.x and 8.x with benchmark v7.0.0 (JeremyFinney-lgtm, 3 failing checks)
- [#2673](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2673) applies the parked-domain criteria to CIS 2.1.8–2.1.10 (JeremyFinney-lgtm, conflicts and 3 failing checks)
- [#2540](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2540) adds the remaining CIS GitHub v1.2.0 checks (thetechgy, +5.2k lines, conflicts and 4 failing checks, carries `attribute-review-override`)

**Fixes**
- [#2715](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2715) `Get-MtSafeMarkdown` now escapes GFM autolinks (earbona23, small)
- [#2699](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2699) stops the last two CIS/AD checks from #2468 passing when their source is absent (earbona23)
- [#2635](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2635) GitHub deletion-access check now uses the configured approvals (thetechgy, +3.6k lines, conflicts, last updated Nov 3)

**Other**
- [#2678](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2678) docs on getting started, choosing a baseline and making the case for Maester (jusso-dev, merges cleanly, no human review yet)
- [#2637](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2637) monthly snapshot automation for agent blocked permissions (Dfrank77, merges cleanly)
- [#2634](https://github.com/maester365/maester/pull/2634) scoped, redacted result exports for the report (thetechgy, conflicts, last updated Nov 2)

**Drafts (skipped):** #2683 (yours, the defender's path), #2706, #2705, #2603.

My notes from earlier today record decisions on #2540, #2637, MT.1266 and the CIS parked-domain scope (#2673). I haven't checked whether these PRs reflect them yet.
